classification_reason: All 12 answers found from repository records with evidence, but two friction items: content search needs world-writable derived state, and stages cannot be inspected by stage id directly.

confusions: First `search --content` failed with Errno 1 writing generated/derived-state — resolved as a sandbox restriction on the product's normal derived-state writes; re-ran world CLI read commands unsandboxed.
los inspect <stage-id> reports 'record not found' — resolved by reading the stage through its study map (inspect study-map-os-l02).
corrective_steps: Ran world CLI commands with filesystem access to the world (product writes derived-state caches on reads).
Read stage status/notes via the parent study map instead of direct stage inspect.
consumer.first_action: Reset the world to fresh (git reset --hard + clean -fd), then listed los.py commands to find the retrieval surface.
consumer.goal: Answer retrieval questions Q01-Q12 from the repository with evidence.
consumer.outcome: All 12 answers recorded in answers.jsonl with record refs and quotes; no world learner-data changes.

friction.cost: 1 retry + environment workaround for all later reads
friction.description: Read commands (search --content) write derived-state caches under generated/, so they fail in a read-only/sandboxed mount of the world; the failure looks like a product error (Errno 1) rather than naming the cache path as the issue.
los inspect does not resolve stage ids (record not found); stages must be read via their parent study map, which newcomers must discover.

internal.derived_changes: 118 derived files added (search/derived-state caches under generated/); canonical digest unchanged.

scenario_record.fresh_method: git reset --hard + git clean -fd in the world (protocol-sanctioned); ignored .venv and generated/ views from S01 survived, tracked tree at initial commit 00becd4.
